lecons.title: Seasons
lecons.summary: A season is a particular period of the year when the weather changes. There are two seasons in Cameroon: the dry season, from October to March, and the rainy season, from March to October. In Europe, there are four: summer, spring, winter and autumn.

explanations.body: Some months are hot and dry, other months are wet: those are seasons.

lecons.title: Soil and the soil profile
lecons.summary: Soil is the upper layer of the earth on which plants grow. There are humus, sandy, clay, volcanic, loam, laterite and silty soils. The soil profile is the vertical arrangement of the soil: top soil, subsoil, parent rock, bed rock.

lecons.title: Vaccination
lecons.summary: Vaccination is the act of introducing a vaccine into the body for protection against a particular disease. It keeps the body healthy, prevents us from contracting diseases and keeps the immune system active. A vaccination campaign gives vaccines to a large population in a given time.
